clause: Vector live effects - 15 Warp presets (one MT) [STU-FX-027]

scope.summary: Implement the 15 vector Warp preset live effects (V,T,G; CPU/No-GPU) sharing a Bend + H/V distortion slider model: Arc, Arc Lower, Arc Upper, Arch, Bulge, Shell Lower, Shell Upper, Flag, Wave, Fish, Rise, Fisheye, Inflate, Squeeze, Twist. Each is a StudioLiveFilter warp kind on live geometry, bake-expandable, sharing one warp-core parameter surface.
acceptance_criteria: Arc, Arc Lower, Arc Upper, Arch, Bulge, Shell Lower, Shell Upper, Flag, Wave, Fish, Rise, Fisheye, Inflate, Squeeze, Twist (15) on shared warp core
expected_tests: test: all 15 warp presets share Bend + H/V distortion core; correct silhouette per preset; bake-expand

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Warp preset set missing or forked into 15 separate implementations.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
